title: nf-core/ribostamp pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline to process bulk and single cell riboSTAMP datasets

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet. Column requirements vary by --mode and start point — see usage docs.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Use absolute paths on cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header.

pipeline_options.title: Pipeline options
pipeline_options.description: Configure the pipeline mode and which analyses to run.

mode.description: Pipeline mode. 'bulk' processes bulk RNA-seq through MARINE and/or SAILOR. 'sc' processes 10x Genomics single-cell RNA-seq through MARINE SC.

run_marine.description: Run MARINE edit calling in bulk mode. Set to false to run SAILOR only.

run_sailor.description: Run SAILOR Bayesian edit calling in bulk mode. Set to false to run MARINE only.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome files and indices required by the pipeline.

genome.description: Genome build key used to select the built-in genePred file for metaPlotR. One of: hg19, hg38, hg38_V44, mm10, mm39.

fasta.description: Path to genome FASTA file. Required for MARINE (samtools calmd) and SAILOR.

star_index.description: Path to pre-built STAR genome index directory. Required for bulk FASTQ mode.

gtf.description: GTF annotation file. Required for STAR alignment (bulk FASTQ) and featureCounts (bulk MARINE).

gene_bed.description: BED6 gene-model file. Used by RSeQC infer_experiment.py for strandedness inference and by MARINE for edit-site annotation.

dbsnp_bed.description: dbSNP BED file (BED3 format). Known SNP positions are removed from MARINE and SAILOR edit calls during filtering.

cellranger_ref.description: Pre-built CellRanger reference directory. Required for --mode sc with FASTQ input.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.

igenomes_base.description: Base path to iGenomes reference files.

edit_calling_options.title: Edit calling options
edit_calling_options.description: Parameters controlling MARINE and SAILOR edit-calling behaviour.

edit_type.description: Type of RNA editing to detect. 'C>T' for A-to-I editing on the reverse strand (most STAMP/DART-seq experiments). 'A>G' for sense-strand A-to-I editing. Used throughout filtering, normalization, and metaPlotR steps.

marine_sif.description: Path to a pre-built MARINE Singularity SIF. If not set, Nextflow automatically pulls and converts docker.io/aravindsundaravadivelu/marine:1.0.2.

ribostamp_utils_sif.description: Path to a pre-built ribostamp_utils Singularity SIF. If not set, Nextflow automatically pulls and converts docker.io/aravindsundaravadivelu/ribostamp_utils:1.0.0.

barcode_tag.description: BAM tag storing cell barcodes. CellRanger uses 'CB'. Only applies to --mode sc.

strandedness.description: Library strandedness: 0=unstranded, 1=forward, 2=reverse. Only required when running SAILOR from BAM input without running MARINE first (strandedness is otherwise inferred per-sample by RSeQC infer_experiment.py).

min_base_quality.description: Minimum base quality (Phred) for MARINE to count a base toward editing evidence.

min_read_quality.description: Minimum read mapping quality for MARINE. Use 255 for CellRanger-mapped BAMs (CellRanger assigns 255 to uniquely mapped reads).

filtering_options.title: Edit filtering options
filtering_options.description: Thresholds for filtering called edit sites after MARINE.

min_count.description: Minimum number of reads with an edit at a site. Applied during SC filtering. Lower values call more sites but increase noise.

max_frac.description: Maximum editing fraction. Sites with a fraction above this cutoff are filtered as likely SNPs or mismatches.

filter_bulk_multiallelic.description: Bulk F1: remove sites where more than one alt base appears at the same contig/position/ref.

filter_bulk_dbsnp.description: Bulk F2: remove edit sites whose position overlaps a dbSNP entry.

filter_bulk_max_frac.description: Bulk F3: remove sites where edit_fraction exceeds --max_frac.

filter_bulk_unannotated.description: Bulk F4: remove sites with no gene annotation (feature_type == -1).

filter_sc_multi_conversion.description: SC F1: remove barcodes with more than one conversion type at the same site.

filter_sc_dbsnp.description: SC F2: remove edit sites whose position overlaps a dbSNP entry.

filter_sc_min_count.description: SC F3: remove sites with fewer than --min_count total edited reads across all cells.

filter_sc_max_frac.description: SC F4: remove sites where edit_fraction exceeds --max_frac.

filter_sc_unannotated.description: SC F5: remove sites with no gene annotation (feature_type == -1).

sailor_options.title: SAILOR options
sailor_options.description: Options for the SAILOR Bayesian edit-calling Snakemake pipeline. Only used when --mode bulk and --run_sailor true.

sailor_snakefile.description: Path to the SAILOR Snakefile. Defaults to the bundled copy at assets/sailor/Snakefile. Override to use a different version.

sailor_snakemake_path.description: Absolute path to the snakemake binary, or 'snakemake' if it is already in PATH. Set this to e.g. '/path/to/conda/envs/snakemake/bin/snakemake' when running under Singularity where snakemake is not in the host PATH.

sailor_singularity_cache.description: Directory for caching SAILOR Singularity images. Will be created if it does not exist.

sailor_singularity_bind.description: Comma-separated bind paths for SAILOR's internal Singularity calls (e.g. '/condo/brannanlab,/home/user/refs'). Must cover the locations of --fasta and --dbsnp_bed.

metagene_options.title: Metagene plot options
metagene_options.description: Options for metaPlotR metagene distance calculation.

genepred.description: Path to a custom genePred annotation file for metaPlotR. If not set, the pipeline selects the built-in file based on --genome (hg19, hg38, hg38_V44, mm10, mm39).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to pipeline test dataset files.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix added to trace report filename.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message.
